question.prompt: Brianna is using part of the money she earned on her weekend job to buy several equally-priced CDs. She used one fifth of her money to buy one third of the CDs. What fraction of her money will she have left after she buys all the CDs?

solutions.explanation:
Because the CDs all have the same price, three groups containing the same number of CDs have the same cost. One third of the CDs costs \(\frac15\) of Brianna's money, so all three thirds cost
\[
3\cdot\frac15=\frac35
\]
of her money. The fraction left is therefore
\[
1-\frac35=\boxed{\frac25},
\]
choice \(\text{C}\).
solutions.title: Scale the cost of one third of the CDs
